## File: facebookresearch_banmo/third_party/detectron2_old/detectron2/data/samplers/distributed_sampler.py

Prompts

```
['create a TrainingSampler that produces an infinite shuffled stream of dataset indices for distributed training', 'create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler that samples indices with configurable repeat factors for imbalanced datasets', 'compute per-image repeat factors from category frequency using the repeat_factors_from_category_frequency static method', 'create an InferenceSampler that produces shard indices for distributed inference across all workers', 'review the TrainingSampler, RepeatFactorTrainingSampler, and InferenceSampler classes and their distributed sampling strategies']
```

Usage

```
{'create_training_sampler': 'create a TrainingSampler that produces an infinite shuffled stream of dataset indices for distributed training', 'create_repeat_factor_sampler': 'create a RepeatFactorTrainingSampler that samples indices with configurable repeat factors for imbalanced datasets', 'compute_repeat_factors_from_frequency': 'compute per-image repeat factors from category frequency using the repeat_factors_from_category_frequency static method', 'create_inference_sampler': 'create an InferenceSampler that produces shard indices for distributed inference across all workers', 'review_distributed_sampler_classes': 'review the TrainingSampler, RepeatFactorTrainingSampler, and InferenceSampler classes and their distributed sampling strategies'}
```
